entry: Working. Change of Command. The formal transfer of command from one officer to another, entered in the log. End of entry.

title: RELIEF OF COMMAND
entry: Working. Relief of Command. The removal of a commanding officer from command, for cause. End of entry.

title: MEDICAL RELIEF OF COMMAND
entry: Working. Medical Relief of Command. The chief medical officer may relieve a commanding officer who is medically unfit, if he can prove it. End of entry.

title: LANDING PARTY PROTOCOL
entry: Working. Landing Party Protocol. Landing parties report regularly by communicator. The ship may recover them at any time. End of entry.

title: AWAY TEAM EQUIPMENT
entry: Working. Away Team Equipment. Communicators, tricorders, and phasers as authorised. End of entry.

title: STANDARD EQUIPMENT ISSUE
entry: Working. Standard Equipment Issue. The equipment issued to personnel for duty. End of entry.

title: PHASER AUTHORIZATION
entry: Working. Phaser Authorization. Phasers are issued on the authority of a senior officer and the security department. End of entry.

title: COMMUNICATOR CHECK
entry: Working. Communicator Check. A check of communicators before a landing party leaves the ship. End of entry.

title: TRICORDER CHECK
entry: Working. Tricorder Check. A check of tricorders before use. End of entry.

title: TRANSPORTER SAFETY CHECK
entry: Working. Transporter Safety Check. A check of the transporter before use, including the pattern buffer and the targeting scanners. End of entry.

title: SHUTTLE LAUNCH PROCEDURE
entry: Working. Shuttle Launch Procedure. See: Shuttlecraft Hangar Operations. End of entry.

title: DAMAGE-CONTROL PARTY
entry: Working. Damage-control Party. See: Damage Control. End of entry.

title: EVACUATION PROCEDURE
entry: Working. Evacuation Procedure. The ordered evacuation of a section or the ship. End of entry.

title: ABANDON SHIP
entry: Working. Abandon Ship. The order to abandon the ship, given only by the captain. End of entry.

title: QUARANTINE
entry: Working. Quarantine. The isolation of personnel or areas to prevent the spread of disease. End of entry.

title: MEDICAL ISOLATION
entry: Working. Medical Isolation. The isolation of a patient in sickbay. End of entry.

title: SECURITY LOCKDOWN
entry: Working. Security Lockdown. The sealing of an area or the ship by the security department. End of entry.

title: DECK SEALING
entry: Working. Deck Sealing. The sealing of a deck by force fields or bulkheads, to contain a threat. End of entry.

title: RESTRICTED AREA
entry: Working. Restricted Area. An area to which access is limited to authorised personnel. End of entry.

title: EVIDENCE CHAIN OF CUSTODY
entry: Working. Evidence Chain of Custody. The record of who has held evidence, and when, so that its integrity can be shown. End of entry.

title: PRISONER TRANSFER
entry: Working. Prisoner Transfer. The transfer of a prisoner to another authority, under guard and on the record. End of entry.

title: DIPLOMATIC GUEST PROTOCOL
entry: Working. Diplomatic Guest Protocol. Diplomatic guests are received with the courtesy due their rank, and protected by the ship's security department. End of entry.

title: DISTRESS CALL
entry: Working. Distress Call. A call for help. Starships respond to distress calls unless ordered otherwise. A distress call may be a trap. End of entry.

title: GENERAL QUARTERS
entry: Working. General Quarters. All hands to their stations. See: Red Alert. End of entry.

title: VULCAN-ROMULAN PEACE INITIATIVE
entry: Working. Vulcan-Romulan Peace Initiative. A diplomatic initiative between Vulcan and the Romulan Star Empire, the first official contact between the two peoples in many years. The Enterprise is in orbit of Vulcan in support. End of entry.

title: VULCAN-ROMULAN PEACE CONFERENCE
entry: Working. Vulcan-Romulan Peace Conference. The conference in ShiKahr at which Vulcan and Romulan delegations meet. Its security is the responsibility of Vulcan Security. End of entry.

title: ROMULAN PEACE DELEGATION
entry: Working. Romulan Peace Delegation. The Romulan delegation to the ShiKahr conference. Its members are accredited by the conference secretariat. End of entry.

title: VULCAN CONFERENCE SECURITY
entry: Working. Vulcan Conference Security. The security arrangements for the conference, under Vulcan Security. End of entry.

title: DIPLOMATIC MURDER INVESTIGATION
entry: Working. Diplomatic Murder Investigation. The investigation of the death of a member of the Romulan delegation in ShiKahr, conducted by Vulcan Security with the assistance of Enterprise officers. Findings are provisional. End of entry.

title: INFILTRATION MATRIX
entry: Working. Infiltration Matrix. A device of Romulan manufacture found installed in the Enterprise's Auxiliary Control, through which the ship's systems were controlled. Analysis is incomplete. End of entry.

title: AUXILIARY CONTROL OVERRIDE
entry: Working. Auxiliary Control Override. The seizure of the ship's control from Auxiliary Control during the current crisis. See: Infiltration Matrix. End of entry.

title: HELM LOCKOUT
entry: Working. Helm Lockout. The loss of helm control from the bridge during the current crisis. End of entry.

title: NAVIGATION LOCKOUT
entry: Working. Navigation Lockout. The loss of navigation control from the bridge during the current crisis. The ship's course was set by the intruders. End of entry.

title: MAXIMUM WARP OVERRIDE
entry: Working. Maximum Warp Override. The holding of the ship at speeds beyond her rated limit during the current crisis, against the chief engineer's protests. End of entry.

title: COMPUTER INFILTRATION
entry: Working. Computer Infiltration. The alteration of the Enterprise computer during the current crisis, so that it hid the intruders and obeyed them. Recovery of the computer's integrity is in progress. End of entry.

title: FALSE VULCAN CREDENTIALS
entry: Working. False Vulcan Credentials. Credentials found in the conference records that do not correspond to any verified Vulcan individual. Investigation is ongoing. End of entry.

title: IMPERSONATION OPERATION
entry: Working. Impersonation Operation. The use of false identities to gain access to the conference and to Federation facilities. Investigation is ongoing. End of entry.

title: SABOTEUR
entry: Working. Saboteur. A person or persons responsible for sabotage aboard the Enterprise during the current crisis. Identities are not confirmed. End of entry.

title: STOLEN STARSHIP
entry: Working. Stolen Starship. A vessel taken without authority. See current mission records. End of entry.

title: REDUCED CREW COMPLEMENT
entry: Working. Reduced Crew Complement. The Enterprise is operating with a reduced crew, the captain, first officer and chief medical officer being absent from the ship. Watch assignments have been adjusted. End of entry.

title: EMERGENCY COMMAND SUCCESSION
entry: Working. Emergency Command Succession. In the absence of the captain and the first officer, command of the Enterprise passes to the senior officer aboard. At present, Lieutenant Commander Montgomery Scott. End of entry.

title: IMPOUNDED ROMULAN VESSEL
entry: Working. Impounded Romulan Vessel. A Romulan Bird-of-Prey impounded at Vulcan during the current crisis. End of entry.

title: ROMULAN BIRD-OF-PREY OPERATIONS
entry: Working. Romulan Bird-of-Prey Operations. Operation of an impounded Romulan Bird-of-Prey by Federation personnel. Its controls are not standard and are not fully understood. End of entry.

title: UNKNOWN DESTINATION
entry: Working. Unknown Destination. The destination of the intruders' course is not known. Sensors give no planet at the end of it. End of entry.

title: VESKAR COLONY
entry: Working. Veskar Colony. See current mission records. End of entry.

title: ASTEROID COLONY
entry: Working. Asteroid Colony. A mining colony among asteroids on the course the Enterprise was forced to follow during the current crisis. End of entry.

title: ACTIVATION DISC
entry: Working. Activation Disc. A component associated with an alien system under investigation. Function and number are not confirmed. End of entry.

title: ANCIENT DATA DISC
entry: Working. Ancient Data Disc. An ancient data storage disc of unknown origin, under analysis. End of entry.

title: ALIEN CONTROL ARTIFACT
entry: Working. Alien Control Artifact. An artifact of alien origin associated with the control of an ancient system. Classified. End of entry.

title: TR-107 TRICORDER, MARK ONE
entry: Working. TR-107 Tricorder, Mark One. Handheld sensing instrument manufactured on Earth in the late twentieth century by Vital Technologies Corporation, one of the earliest attempts to build a portable multi-function scanner. The unit measured electromagnetic fields, temperature, barometric pressure, and light intensity and frequency. A production run of ten thousand units was announced; considerably fewer were completed before the manufacturer ceased trading, and surviving working examples are prized by collectors of early scientific instruments. Primitive by current standards, its design anticipates the Starfleet tricorder by nearly three centuries. End of entry.

title: JAMES T. KIRK
entry: Working. Kirk, James Tiberius. Captain, Starfleet. Service number S C nine three seven, dash zero one seven six C E C. Human male. Born March twenty-second, twenty-two thirty-three, Riverside, Iowa, Earth. Current assignment: commanding officer, U.S.S. Enterprise, N C C one seven zero one. Command division. Kirk entered Starfleet Academy in twenty-two fifty and subsequently served aboard the U.S.S. Republic and U.S.S. Farragut. His service record includes command experience in exploration, first-contact operations, diplomatic missions, and combat conditions. Kirk assumed command of the Enterprise in twenty-two sixty-five. Decorations and commendations include multiple awards for valor and distinguished service. Psychological evaluations note a strong identification with command responsibility, rapid decision-making under pressure, and an unusually high tolerance for calculated operational risk. Current medical status: fit for command duty. Personnel file access complete.

title: SPOCK
entry: Working. Spock. Commander, Starfleet. Service number S one seven nine, dash two seven six S P. Vulcan-Human male. Born January sixth, twenty-two thirty, ShiKahr, Vulcan. Son of Ambassador Sarek of Vulcan and Amanda Grayson of Earth. Current assignment: first officer and science officer, U.S.S. Enterprise, N C C one seven zero one. Sciences division. Spock entered Starfleet service after declining admission to the Vulcan Science Academy. His specialties include astrophysics, computer science, sensor analysis, exobiology, and command operations. He has served aboard the Enterprise under Captain Christopher Pike and Captain James T. Kirk. Medical record notes standard Vulcan physiological characteristics, including copper-based blood chemistry, elevated body temperature, enhanced strength, and telepathic capability. Security note: subject is qualified for command and has unrestricted access to primary scientific and command systems. Personnel file access complete.

title: LEONARD H. McCOY
entry: Working. McCoy, Leonard H. Lieutenant Commander, Starfleet Medical. Human male. Born twenty-two twenty-seven, Georgia, Earth. Current assignment: chief medical officer, U.S.S. Enterprise, N C C one seven zero one. Medical division. Doctor McCoy is a licensed physician and surgeon with advanced qualifications in general medicine, emergency surgery, xenobiology, pathology, and space medicine. He maintains primary medical responsibility for the Enterprise complement and has authority to relieve personnel from duty when medically required, including the commanding officer. McCoy’s service record includes extensive treatment of non-human physiologies and medical emergencies encountered during deep-space operations. Professional evaluations describe exceptional diagnostic instincts and a strong preference for direct clinical observation over automated conclusions. He is a frequent member of landing parties when medical expertise is required. Current medical status: fit for duty. Starfleet service number is retained in the personnel database. Personnel file access complete.

title: MONTGOMERY SCOTT
entry: Working. Scott, Montgomery. Lieutenant Commander, Starfleet. Service number S E one nine seven five four T. Human male. Born twenty-two twenty-two, Scotland, Earth. Current assignment: chief engineer, U.S.S. Enterprise, N C C one seven zero one. Engineering division. Scott is qualified in warp propulsion, matter-antimatter systems, impulse engineering, transporter systems, damage control, and starship power distribution. He has repeatedly assumed temporary command of the Enterprise during the absence or incapacitation of senior command personnel. Engineering evaluations credit Scott with an exceptional ability to restore damaged systems under severe time and resource limitations. He is authorized for direct control of the Enterprise warp engines, engineering computer, emergency power systems, and main energizer. Personnel notes record a strong personal attachment to the vessels and machinery under his care. Current medical status: fit for duty. Personnel file access complete.

title: NYOTA UHURA
entry: Working. Uhura, Nyota. Lieutenant, Starfleet. Human female. Born twenty-two thirty-seven, Kenya, Earth. Current assignment: communications officer, U.S.S. Enterprise, N C C one seven zero one. Operations division. Lieutenant Uhura is qualified in subspace communications, signal analysis, cryptography, linguistics, communications repair, and command-bridge operations. She routinely supervises ship-to-ship, ship-to-surface, and Starfleet communications traffic and is responsible for analysis of unidentified or degraded transmissions. Her linguistic training includes multiple Federation and non-Federation languages, with additional proficiency in rapid interpretation of unfamiliar communications structures. Uhura is bridge-command qualified and has demonstrated the ability to operate navigation, communications, and auxiliary control systems when required. Personnel evaluations cite exceptional auditory discrimination, technical competence, and composure during emergency conditions. Current medical status: fit for duty. Starfleet service number is retained in the personnel database. Personnel file access complete.

title: HIKARU SULU
entry: Working. Sulu, Hikaru. Lieutenant, Starfleet. Service number two three two, dash seven one eight four six. Human male. Born twenty-two thirty-seven, San Francisco, California, Earth. Current assignment: senior helmsman, U.S.S. Enterprise, N C C one seven zero one. Command division. Lieutenant Sulu is qualified in starship helm control, orbital operations, combat maneuvering, shuttlecraft operation, navigation support, and bridge command procedures. His scientific background includes botany and related life-science disciplines. Recreational qualifications include fencing and advanced hand-to-hand combat. Sulu has piloted the Enterprise during numerous high-risk maneuvers, including combat operations, planetary approaches, and emergency navigation conditions. Performance evaluations note excellent spatial judgment, rapid response time, and consistent control under extreme acceleration and tactical pressure. He is authorized to assume additional bridge responsibilities when senior officers are unavailable. Current medical status: fit for duty. Personnel file access complete.

title: PAVEL A. CHEKOV
entry: Working. Chekov, Pavel Andreievich. Ensign, Starfleet. Service number six five six, dash five eight two seven B. Human male. Born twenty-two forty-five, Russia, Earth. Current assignment: navigator, U.S.S. Enterprise, N C C one seven zero one. Command division. Ensign Chekov is qualified in navigation, astrogation, helm support, weapons control, sensor operation, and bridge tactical procedures. His duties include computation and verification of interstellar courses, orbital insertion data, emergency navigation solutions, and operation of bridge weapons systems when assigned. Chekov has also served on landing parties and security details during Enterprise missions. Academy records indicate strong performance in mathematics, navigation theory, and tactical systems. Personnel evaluations note high enthusiasm, rapid technical recall, and a tendency toward competitive national pride. Security clearance permits access to standard bridge command, navigation, and tactical systems appropriate to rank and duty assignment. Current medical status: fit for duty. Personnel file access complete.

title: CHRISTINE CHAPEL
entry: Working. Chapel, Christine. Lieutenant, Starfleet Medical. Service number N I, dash five nine six, M T two one Z. Human female. Born approximately twenty-two thirty-seven, Cleveland, Ohio, Earth. Current assignment: head nurse, U.S.S. Enterprise, N C C one seven zero one. Medical division. Chapel possesses professional training in nursing, biological research, laboratory procedure, emergency medicine, and xenomedical support. Before her Enterprise assignment, she pursued a career in bio-research and worked with Doctor Roger Korby. Her present duties include surgical assistance, patient monitoring, laboratory analysis, medication control, and supervision of sickbay nursing procedures under Chief Medical Officer Leonard McCoy. Chapel is qualified to operate standard Starfleet medical scanners, diagnostic beds, laboratory equipment, and emergency treatment systems. Her Starfleet identification record confirms service number N I, dash five nine six, M T two one Z. Current medical status: fit for duty. Personnel file access complete.

title: JOHN KYLE
entry: Working. Kyle, John. Lieutenant, Starfleet. Human male. Current assignment: transporter officer and technical specialist, U.S.S. Enterprise, N C C one seven zero one. Operations division. Lieutenant Kyle is qualified in transporter control, transporter maintenance, matter-stream monitoring, coordinate acquisition, and bridge technical operations. His Enterprise service has included duty in the transporter room, on the bridge, and at other technical stations as operational requirements dictate. Kyle is authorized to perform personnel and cargo transport under normal conditions and to supervise emergency transport procedures when senior engineering officers are unavailable. Performance reports describe a methodical operator with strong procedural discipline and extensive practical familiarity with Enterprise transporter systems. He has participated in landing-party support, emergency beam-out operations, and transport sequences conducted under hazardous environmental and tactical conditions. Current medical status: fit for duty. Personnel file access complete.

title: GIOTTO
entry: Working. Giotto. Lieutenant Commander, Starfleet. Human male. Current assignment: senior security officer, U.S.S. Enterprise, N C C one seven zero one. Security division. Lieutenant Commander Giotto is qualified in shipboard security, landing-party command, tactical response, phaser operations, detention procedures, and emergency defense coordination. His duties include organization of security teams, protection of critical shipboard areas, investigation of internal security incidents, and support of landing parties operating in potentially hostile environments. Giotto has commanded Enterprise security personnel during encounters involving dangerous indigenous life, hostile boarders, and other high-risk conditions. Service evaluations note a direct command style, strong unit discipline, and willingness to personally accompany security teams into hazardous situations. Security clearance includes access to the ship’s armory, detention facilities, internal surveillance systems, and restricted tactical information appropriate to assignment. Current medical status: fit for duty. Personnel file access complete.

title: KEVIN RILEY
entry: Working. Riley, Kevin Thomas. Lieutenant, Starfleet. Human male. Born on Earth. Current assignment: U.S.S. Enterprise, N C C one seven zero one. Operations division. Lieutenant Riley is qualified in engineering support, navigation, communications procedures, and general starship operations. His Enterprise service record includes bridge and engineering duty, together with temporary assignments requiring independent monitoring of critical ship systems. Riley is a survivor of the Kodos massacre on Tarsus Four, a fact retained in his medical and psychological records under restricted access. Subsequent evaluations found him fit for unrestricted Starfleet duty. Professional reports describe Riley as technically capable, socially outgoing, and dependable under normal operating conditions. He is qualified to operate multiple standard Enterprise control stations and may be assigned to engineering or bridge support according to mission requirements. Current medical status: fit for duty. Personnel file access complete.

title: JOSEPH M’BENGA
entry: Working. M’Benga, Joseph. Doctor, Starfleet Medical. Human male. Current assignment: medical officer, U.S.S. Enterprise, N C C one seven zero one. Medical division. Doctor M’Benga is a physician and surgeon with specialist knowledge of Vulcan physiology and treatment. His professional training includes an extended medical internship on Vulcan, giving him experience with Vulcan anatomy, neurophysiology, blood chemistry, and emergency therapeutic procedures. Aboard the Enterprise, M’Benga serves under Chief Medical Officer Leonard McCoy and may assume responsibility for sickbay when required. His specialist knowledge makes him a preferred attending physician in cases involving Vulcan patients, particularly when conventional human treatment protocols are inappropriate. He is qualified in surgery, emergency medicine, xenobiology, diagnostic systems, and standard Starfleet field medicine. Medical clearance permits landing-party assignment when specialist care is required. Current medical status: fit for duty. Personnel file access complete.

title: PELL
entry: Working. Pell, Marcus A. Lieutenant, Starfleet. Service number S C eight four one, dash two two zero seven M P L. Human male. Born February seventeenth, twenty-two thirty-six, Wellington, New Zealand, Earth. Current assignment: operations and engineering support officer, U.S.S. Enterprise, N C C one seven zero one. Operations division. Lieutenant Pell is qualified in starship systems monitoring, damage-control coordination, auxiliary power management, environmental systems, and emergency bridge operations. He transferred to the Enterprise following service aboard the U.S.S. Lexington, where he received a commendation for coordinating evacuation and power isolation during a major engineering casualty. Enterprise evaluations describe Pell as calm, technically adaptable, and particularly effective when several damaged systems must be prioritized simultaneously. He is cross-qualified for auxiliary control and may supervise secondary engineering stations during alert conditions. Security clearance includes standard operations systems and restricted engineering access appropriate to duty assignment. Current medical status: fit for duty. Personnel file access complete.
